are_you_ok.title: H-E-B jalapeño product recall includes guacamole, prepared foods and more over salmonella concerns
are_you_ok.summary: H-E-B, the San Antonio-based grocery chain that dominates Texas, recalled jalapeño products over possible salmonella contamination, saying what remained on its shelves was safe. The recall then widened: dozens more items the chain makes in its own stores — guacamole and other prepared foods among them — came off the shelves because they were made with the affected peppers.
are_you_ok.description: Dozens of H-E-B products made in stores were also removed because they contained items impacted by the recall.

you_should_know.title: City Manager Erik Walsh addresses San Antonio leaders about 'misinformation' ahead of meeting on Spurs arena ballot measure
you_should_know.summary: The fight over public funding for a new Spurs arena reached City Hall: City Manager Erik Walsh pushed back on what he called misinformation circulating among city leaders, ahead of a council debate over whether to put the funding question to a residential vote.

you_should_know.title: Texas lawmakers call on six Bexar County cities to end 287(g) agreements with ICE
you_should_know.summary: U.S. Rep. Joaquin Castro and other Texas lawmakers called on six cities in Bexar County — the county that contains San Antonio — to end their 287(g) agreements with ICE, the arrangements that let local police act as federal immigration officers, arguing they cost community trust and invite racial profiling.
you_should_know.description: U.S. Rep. Joaquin Castro and others urge six Bexar County cities to end their 287(g) agreements with ICE, citing trust issues and racial profiling concerns.

you_should_know.title: SAPD officers seen fatally shooting armed suspect in newly shared bodycam video
you_should_know.summary: Newly released bodycam video showed San Antonio police fatally shooting an armed man during an early-morning encounter that began when officers tried to stop him for riding a bicycle on the sidewalk and he attempted to get away.
you_should_know.description: The early morning confrontation began with police trying to stop a bicyclist on the sidewalk before he is seen in the footage trying to escape.

you_should_know.title: Meta, Open AI commit to Texas data center rules as Gov. Abbott orders strict power, water audits
you_should_know.summary: With AI data centers drawing backlash in North Texas, the Dallas-Fort Worth region, Meta, Google and Open AI committed to Gov. Abbott's new rules for the industry, as the state ordered strict audits of how much power and water the facilities use.
you_should_know.description: As AI data centers face North Texas backlash, Meta, Google and Open AI promise to play by Gov. Abbott’s new rules to protect the grid.

you_should_know.title: FBI conducts court-authorized operations in San Antonio neighborhood, but details are unknown
you_should_know.summary: Residents of a West Side neighborhood — the historically Mexican-American part of San Antonio just west of downtown — woke early one Friday to a large FBI operation on their street. The bureau confirmed only that the action was court-authorized, leaving the reason for it unexplained.
you_should_know.description: Residents of a west-side neighborhood awoke to a surprise FBI operation early Friday morning. The agency confirmed it was conducting a court-authorized action.
